name: Micropedia AI Search Optimizer
author: Marco Ilardi

sections.description:
Micropedia AI Search Optimizer helps site owners publish AI-readable content layers such as llms.txt, clean text exports, optional Markdown exports, crawler preferences and structured semantic metadata without modifying original posts, theme HTML, SEO plugin metadata, canonicals, or existing content.

This plugin does not guarantee inclusion, ranking, indexing, visibility, traffic, or citation by AI systems. It only improves content readability, accessibility, and machine-readable structure.

What makes it different

Unlike a basic llms.txt generator, this plugin is designed as a non-destructive AI readability layer for WordPress. It provides optional AI-readable endpoints, Markdown exports, AI crawler preference controls, compatibility checks for major SEO plugins, reversible settings and safe defaults.

Features

  • Optional /llms.txt endpoint
  • Optional /llms-full.txt endpoint
  • Optional Markdown exports at /micropedia-ai-md/post-slug.md
  • AI crawler preferences for OAI-SearchBot, GPTBot, Google-Extended, PerplexityBot and ClaudeBot
  • Basic JSON-LD output when Yoast SEO, Rank Math or SEOPress schema providers are not detected
  • Optional AI readiness score column
  • Plugin language override for English, Italian, French and Spanish
  • Non-destructive and reversible settings

Compatibility

The plugin checks for Yoast SEO, Rank Math and SEOPress before outputting its own JSON-LD. It does not modify SEO metadata, canonical URLs, theme HTML or original content.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/micropedia-ai-search-optimizer directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Micropedia AI in the admin menu to configure the options.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin guarantee AI visibility or indexing?

No. The plugin does not guarantee inclusion, ranking, indexing, visibility, traffic, or citation by AI systems. It improves readability and accessibility for machine-readable content layers.

Does it change my posts or theme output?

No. The plugin is designed to be non-destructive. It does not overwrite posts, modify theme HTML, change canonical URLs or alter SEO plugin metadata.

Does it duplicate schema from SEO plugins?

No. If Yoast SEO, Rank Math or SEOPress are detected, the plugin avoids outputting its own JSON-LD.
